title: Calculation of prompt diphoton production cross sections
abstract: A fully differential calculation in perturbative quantum chromodynamics is presented for the production of photon pairs at hadron colliders.

title: Sparsity-certifying graph decompositions
abstract: We describe a new algorithm for decomposing a graph into edge-disjoint spanning trees, and prove it certifies sparsity in linear time.

title: Surface code quantum error correction at threshold
abstract: We simulate the surface code under a depolarizing noise model and estimate the error correction threshold to be close to one percent.

title: Quantum error correction with bosonic modes
abstract: Bosonic codes protect quantum information without the overhead of a full surface code. We compare cat codes and binomial codes under photon loss.

title: A compiler for reversible circuits
abstract: We present a compiler that maps classical reversible computation onto quantum circuits with a bounded number of ancilla qubits.

title: Computational complexity of graph isomorphism
abstract: The computation required to decide graph isomorphism remains quasipolynomial. We survey recent progress and the remaining obstacles.

title: Machine learning for medical image segmentation
abstract: Convolutional networks now match expert radiologists on several medical segmentation benchmarks. We review the evidence and its limitations.

title: Learning machine translation from monolingual corpora
abstract: Unsupervised machine translation learns a mapping between languages without parallel text, using only monolingual corpora and a shared embedding space.

title: Inverted index compression revisited
abstract: We compare delta encoding, variable byte codes and Elias-Fano for compressing postings lists, measuring both index size and query latency.

title: Efficient phrase queries over positional indexes
abstract: A positional inverted index answers phrase queries by intersecting position lists. We show a two-pointer merge beats hashing at every corpus size we tested.

title: Proximity operators in Boolean retrieval
abstract: Boolean retrieval systems have long supported proximity operators. We formalise NEAR and its ordered variant, and give an evaluation algorithm.

title: Galloping search for list intersection
abstract: Exponential, or galloping, search intersects a short list with a long one in logarithmic time per element rather than linear time.

title: Thermal transport in two-dimensional materials
abstract: We measure the in-plane thermal conductivity of suspended monolayer samples and find a strong dependence on isotopic purity.

title: Non-equilibrium dynamics of ultracold atoms
abstract: A quantum gas quenched across a phase transition develops topological defects whose density follows the Kibble-Zurek scaling law.

title: Gravitational waves from binary neutron stars
abstract: The inspiral and merger of a binary neutron star system produces a characteristic chirp. We model the waveform including tidal deformability.

title: Naïve Bayes revisited for text classification
abstract: Despite its naïve independence assumption, Bayes classification remains a strong baseline for text classification — often within a few points of far costlier models.

title: Rust-like ownership for systems verification
abstract: An affine type system in the style of Rust lets a verifier reason about aliasing locally, without a global heap invariant.

title: 量子誤り訂正符号の構成について
abstract: We give a construction of quantum error correcting codes over non-binary alphabets, with an abstract in mixed scripts to exercise Unicode handling.

title: Comparative study of computer architectures
abstract: Computer architecture, compilers and computational workloads co-evolve. We compare three generations of designs on a common benchmark suite.

title: State-of-the-art: hyphenated terms and apostrophes
abstract: This record exists to exercise tokenization: it's full of hyphenated terms, apostrophes, e.g. abbreviations, and numbers like 3.14 and 1,000.
